name: Hair / Thread Algae
description: Long green strands (hair / thread / Oedogonium-type) riding excess nutrients under long, bright photoperiods. The fastest spreader of the four when light + nutrients run high. growthRate / lightDependence are MODELLED tuning weights, not measured rates.
notes: Amano shrimp + SAE graze soft new growth eagerly; mature tufts are best manually twirled out. Shorten the photoperiod and stabilize CO2 to control.
